what: Where an authorized actor obtains each identity-bearing argument of a client RPC through ordinary PINTAR. Read by scripts/dev/reachability.mjs at development time only. NOTHING READS THIS AT RUNTIME and it grants nothing: authorization lives in the database, in the predicates each function calls.
why: WP7D. Management was authorized to open a feedback cycle and had no governed read from which to learn the subject's person_id. The gap was found after the surface was built. A declaration that is missing here is that question, asked early.

sources.rpc:<name>: another client-callable RPC this same actor may call
sources.rls:<relation>: a relation the actor may select under its own RLS policy
sources.self: the caller's own identity — current_person_id() / auth.uid()
sources.arg:<name>: derived from another argument of the same call
sources.caller_choice: a value the caller invents: a new uuid, an idempotency key

coverage: Seeded with the feedback domain, where the gap was found, and extended as each work package touches a client surface. WP8 declares the report-configuration path. The rest of the client surface is reported as undeclared rather than assumed correct. BOB-01 declares the school-structure path. BOB-02 declares the lesson-package path.

open_feedback_cycle.actor: HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT or DEAN standing over the class
open_feedback_cycle.note: p_subject_person_id is the WP7D argument. Its source must be a STAFF read available to the same Management actor; before WP7D there was none, which is the state this file exists to make visible.

close_feedback_cycle.actor: HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT or DEAN standing over the class
close_feedback_cycle.note: Management reaches a cycle it already governs; feedback_result is the STAFF read that names it.

feedback_subjects_for_class.actor: HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT or DEAN standing over the class
feedback_subjects_for_class.note: The class is the node the reader already stands over and can see in the org tree.

feedback_result.actor: HEAD_OF_DEPARTMENT or DEAN standing over the class
feedback_result.note: A cycle id is discovered from the class the Management actor governs, never guessed.

feedback_questionnaire.actor: the learner the round is asking
feedback_questionnaire.note: A learner may know only their own eligibility, so the only governed source is their own list.

submit_feedback.actor: the learner the round is asking
submit_feedback.note: Same source as the questionnaire: the sheet is answered for a cycle the learner was offered.

save_report_template.actor: INSTITUTION_ADMIN or SYSTEM_ADMIN holding CAN_MANAGE_REPORT_TEMPLATES in that institution
save_report_template.note: The institution is one the administrator already stands in and can read; an existing template to revise is read from their own school's templates under RLS. The metrics are chosen from metric_definitions, which is PINTAR's and readable by anyone signed in — and they are not identity-bearing arguments, they are catalogue keys.

generate_report.actor: any member of the institution; what they may SEE is decided per metric by metric_evaluate
generate_report.note: Both are ordinary reads the reader already has. Reading a report requires standing in the institution; it does NOT require the capability that saved the template, and each metric is re-authorized against the reader.

grant_role.actor: an active SYSTEM_ADMIN, or an INSTITUTION_ADMIN over the target node
grant_role.note: The final release delta. p_person had no governed source for a person with no prior relationship: the only granting surface listed people from enrolments, transfers and existing roles, so a school's first administrator could not be selected. persons_awaiting_first_role is that source for exactly those people; everyone else is already reachable through rls:role_assignments, rls:enrollments or rls:transfers.

school_structure.actor: an Admin sekolah (INSTITUTION_ADMIN at the school) or an Admin platform (SYSTEM_ADMIN)
school_structure.note: BOB-01. The school the administrator already sees in Konfigurasi.

create_bagian.actor: an Admin sekolah (INSTITUTION_ADMIN at the school) or an Admin platform (SYSTEM_ADMIN)
create_bagian.note: BOB-01. The same school; the hidden Jenjang and Reguler are the database's, never an argument.

create_tingkat.actor: an Admin sekolah (INSTITUTION_ADMIN at the school) or an Admin platform (SYSTEM_ADMIN)
create_tingkat.note: BOB-01. A BAGIAN row's node_id from the school's own structure list.

create_kelas.actor: an Admin sekolah (INSTITUTION_ADMIN at the school) or an Admin platform (SYSTEM_ADMIN)
create_kelas.note: BOB-01. A TINGKAT row's node_id from the school's own structure list.

rename_school_node.actor: an Admin sekolah (INSTITUTION_ADMIN at the school) or an Admin platform (SYSTEM_ADMIN)
rename_school_node.note: BOB-01. Any row's node_id from the structure list; hidden nodes are never listed, so never offered.

deactivate_school_node.actor: an Admin sekolah (INSTITUTION_ADMIN at the school) or an Admin platform (SYSTEM_ADMIN)
deactivate_school_node.note: BOB-01. Any row's node_id from the structure list.

prepare_ingest_batch.actor: a person holding CAN_DRAFT in the batch's school (Guru, Kepala departemen, Admin sekolah, Admin platform)
prepare_ingest_batch.note: BOB-02. The id the caller's own insert into ingest_batches returned, or a row of the Unggah list.

confirm_ingest_batch.actor: a person holding CAN_DRAFT in the batch's school (Guru, Kepala departemen, Admin sekolah, Admin platform)
confirm_ingest_batch.note: BOB-02. The batch the caller prepared, as the Unggah list shows it awaiting confirmation.

create_release.actor: a person holding CAN_FREEZE_RELEASE in the course's school (Kepala departemen, Admin sekolah, Admin platform)
create_release.note: BOB-03. The course the Studio's package page shows, once it is APPROVED.

freeze_release.actor: a person holding CAN_FREEZE_RELEASE in the release's school, other than the course's author
freeze_release.note: BOB-03. A row of the package page's release list, or the id create_release returned.

assign_release.actor: a person holding CAN_ASSIGN_LEARNING in the class's school (Guru, Kepala departemen, Admin sekolah)
assign_release.note: BOB-04. A published release from the teacher's Siapkan list (pengajar.terbitan) and the class the teacher is looking at.
